dedupe_keys.name: empirical data archive characterising water services in ontario first nations and municipalities 2009 2010

description: This archive characterises drinking water services in Ontario First Nations and municipalities for 2009-2010, built for a study of water sharing arrangements between the two. Master tables with data dictionaries join municipal and First Nations water system data, drinking water advisories, census characteristics, the Community Well-Being Index, historic climate and geography, and the archive keeps the source annual reports, summary reports and ministry inspection reports for each system. Researchers at the University of Guelph produced it (project 2018-2025) and released it on Borealis in November 2024 as a free download; the master files and project information are under CC BY 4.0, while source documents keep their own terms. Coverage is regional for Ontario. Caveats: the data describe 2009-2010 conditions only, and the reports vary by system. Simulation uses: service reliability and advisory patterns for equity-aware resilience and capacity planning of small drinking water systems. Related records: the BC Municipal Water Survey (data-bc-municipal-water-survey-2016) and Canada's Core Public Infrastructure Survey (data-statcan-canada-core-public-infrastructure-survey).
